body:
## Summary
Wire bidirectional cross-ref between \`audit-session\` and \`learn-from-mistakes\` skills.

\`audit-session\` Phase 7 now explicitly surfaces unsaved learning candidates when friction triggers (user pushback / rollback / twice-failed test / rediscovered ruled-out answer) fired during the session without \`learn-from-mistakes\` activating. Capture-in-the-moment remains preferred; the cross-ref is the safety net.

\`learn-from-mistakes\` mirrors the cross-ref in its activation section. Both frontmatter descriptions advertise the wiring.

## Why
Friction triggers can silently slip through a long session — operator pushes back on a wrong assumption mid-flight, agent rolls back a change, test fails twice — without the \`learn-from-mistakes\` self-activation actually firing. Today nothing catches that. The cross-ref makes \`audit-session\`'s end-of-session sweep the explicit safety net.

Hard-no: \`audit-session\` does NOT auto-invoke \`learn-from-mistakes\`. It only surfaces the gap in the consolidated hand-back so the operator decides whether to capture or drop.

## Companion
Mirrors \`trilamsr/Leah#187\` which ported both skills to leah with the same cross-ref wiring.

## Test plan
- [ ] Reviewer confirms cross-ref language matches in both skills.
- [ ] Confirms hard-no remains "NO auto-invoke other skills".
- [ ] Confirms no functional surface changes beyond surfacing gaps in hand-back.
title: [docs] Cross-ref audit-session Phase 7 with learn-from-mistakes

body:
## Summary

Add `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE` recommendation token to reviewer template + verdict gate. Add negative-space audit requirement. Gitignore `.regatta/worktrees/` (closes #1195).

## Root cause

Reviewer default `APPROVE` under uncertainty is the silent-failure mode behind multiple recurring traps this session (PR #1228 test stub flakiness, PR #1225 partial-cascade discovered post-merge). Reviewer template lacked an explicit "I cannot verify confidence" token. Operators couldn't distinguish "fully reviewed + approved" from "checked surface w/ partial coverage."

Adds `Reviewer-recommendation: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE` + mandatory `Confidence-evidence-needed: #NNN` tracker issue. Gate fails closed on either missing.

Negative-space audit: reviewer MUST enumerate ≥3 PR-specific bypass attempts citing `path:line`. Each disposition: `mitigated` / `accepted` / `filed #NNN`. Forces adversarial coverage proof.

`.regatta/worktrees/` gitignore: agent worktrees consistently break `make check` via prose-dup duplicates (hit 3× this session) per #1195.

## Test plan

- [x] `bash scripts/check-reviewer-verdict_test.sh` exit 0 (50 tests pass, incl new `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE fails and prompts resolution` + `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE without Confidence-evidence-needed token fails`)
- [x] `make check` exit 0 (after agent-worktree sweep)
- [x] Reviewer template DoD includes new line: `negative-space audit: ≥3 PR-specific bypass attempts ...`
- [x] verdict gate exit codes: 0 pass, 1 missing token, 2 REVISE/BLOCK/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, 3 usage

```release-notes
[FEAT] reviewer: new `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE` recommendation token requires `Confidence-evidence-needed: #NNN` tracker; negative-space audit (≥3 PR-specific bypass attempts w/ disposition) mandatory for load-bearing PRs. Closes silent-APPROVE-under-uncertainty trap.
```

## A+ Scorecard

| # | Criterion | Self |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Correctness | A+ |
| 2 | Simplicity | A — additive, no breaking changes to existing tokens |
| 3 | TDD | A — failing tests for new token paths land w/ implementation; verdict_test.sh expanded |
| 4 | Test coverage | A+ — 50 verdict-gate tests + new INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE coverage |
| 5 | Reviewer gate | A+ — load-bearing CI gate change requires independent reviewer |
| 6 | No self-tag | A+ — Reviewer-* tokens left for operator-spawned reviewer |
| 7 | TDD cited | A — feedback_tdd_discipline referenced in template |
| 8 | No automerge | A+ — operator-mediated |
| 9 | Comments | A — WHY-only; closes-the-trap rationale inline |
| 10 | PR hygiene | A+ — `--body-file`, release-notes fence, closes-keyword |

Closes #1195.
title: [FEAT] reviewer: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE token + negative-space audit + .regatta/worktrees gitignore (closes #1195)
